title: Jesus, I Will Ponder Now
description: Jesus, I Will Ponder Now in Tonic Solfa to AURELIA, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 6 verses and a piano.
about: Sigmund von Birken wrote these words in German. August Crull's translation was printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 192.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens and Sixes Double (7.6.7.6.7.6.7.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to AURELIA; any other Sevens and Sixes Double tune fits them as well.
underlay: Je-sus, I will pon-der now On Thy ho-ly Pas-sion; With Thy Spir-it me en-dow For such med-i-ta-tion. Grant that I in love and faith May the i-mage cher-ish Of Thy suf-fering, pain, and death, That I may not per-ish.

lines: Grant that I in love and faith
Of Thy suffering, pain, and death,
Make me see Thy great distress,
Make me see how scourge and rod,
Spear and nails did wound Thee,
How for man Thou diedst, O God,
Who with thorns had crowned Thee.
Yet, O Lord, not thus alone
But its cause to me make known
Ah! I also and my sin
This the cause alone hath been
Grant that I Thy Passion view
How could I refuse to shun
Since for me God’s only Son
If my sins give me alarm
Let Thy cross my fear disarm,
Grant that I may trust in Thee
If His Son so loveth me,
May I give Thee love for love.
That I may in heaven above

licence: Public domain: Sigmund von Birken died in 1681; August Crull died in 1923.
credits: Words by Sigmund von Birken (1626–1681), translated by August Crull (1845–1923), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to AURELIA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
